title: V1.9.11 Hidden-Zone Search/Reveal/Reorder Release Smoke
preconditions: V1.9.11 Detailed Plan, Requirements, Spec and Test Matrix freeze exactly 16 Hidden-Zone cards.
No V1.9.12+ counter, virus, trace, damage or run-flow card is part of this release.
steps: Start deterministic V1.9.11 smoke games with the V1.9.11 runner and corp fixtures.
Verify Runner stack search: choice is side-private, selected program moves to grip and stack shuffle is deterministic.
Verify Gideon's Pawnshop: choice comes from Runner trash, selected card moves to grip, the played Pawnshop is not selectable, and the stack is not shuffled.
Verify reveal and expose: only the intentionally revealed CardDefinition is public.
Verify installed Runner helpers: LegalActions expose/search/reorder only through V1.9.11 PendingChoices.
Verify Corporate Downsizing and Ice Pick Willie: R&D top reveal is public without leaking the rest of R&D.
Verify Too Many Doors: Corp-private R&D top-two reorder choice is replay- and StateHash-stable.
Verify AI: multi-card Hidden-Zone choices are answered completely through LegalActions and PlayerView data.
expected: All 16 V1.9.11 cards are human_playable, deck_legal and ai_supported.
All new decisions run through LegalActions and applyAction revalidation.
PlayerViews, PublicEvents, AI inputs, reconnect payloads and scenario data contain no hidden opponent card order.
No new card outside the V1.9.11 target set is promoted.

coverageRefs.ai: packages/ai/src/index.test.ts::answers V1.9.11 Corp R&D reorder choices with all required side-safe options
